description: The complete column-level lineage of a defining-SQL object (MaterializedView, VirtualTable, SearchIndex). Records, for each output column, how it derives from the columns of the object's immediate sources. Expressed only against immediate sources; transitive resolution composes across documents. Computed from the defining SQL and bound schema and cached; it is fully derivable and is not migrated between stacks.

objectId.description: The id of the object this provenance describes, e.g. 'syn123'.

versionNumber.description: The version of the object this provenance describes. Null when the provenance is for the current (unversioned) schema.

columns.description: One entry per output column of the object, in select-list order.
